caption: A struck tuning fork is brought up to a ping-pong ball hanging on a thread, and the ball is kicked away and swings.

sa.check: A ping-pong ball hangs on a thread.
A tuning fork is brought up to the ball.
The ball is kicked away from the fork.
The fork is shown being struck, or its prongs show a blur.
The fork approaches first; the kick and the swing follow.

pc.expect: The ball hangs still until the prongs touch it and moves off only on contact.
pc.fail: The ball swings away before the fork reaches it; or the prongs touch it and it hangs unmoved; or the ball moves toward the fork on its own.

pc.expect: The ball is knocked outward, swings back and is kicked again if it returns to the ringing fork; with the fork withdrawn its swing shrinks.
pc.fail: The ball swings ever wider with the fork held away; or stops dead in mid-swing; or is kicked again with the fork withdrawn; or comes to rest pressed against the prongs while they are still blurred.

pc.expect: The thread stays taut with the ball hanging below its fixing; at rest the ball hangs straight down.
pc.fail: The thread goes slack while the ball stays up; or the ball rises above its fixing; or rests tilted with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The ball and the fork stay rigid and the thread stays straight.
pc.fail: The ball dents and stays dented; or the prongs bend; or the thread stretches.

pc.expect: One ball, one fork; the prongs do not pass through the ball.
pc.fail: A second ball appears; or the ball vanishes; or the prongs pass through the ball; or the fork changes shape.

pc.expect: The ball's colour, the fork's size and the thread's length stay the same.
pc.fail: The ball changes colour; or the fork changes size; or the thread changes length.

note: The hand holding the fork is a trigger and is not judged.
